observation.command:
cd /workspace && printf 'tex2pdf-service\n\nVersion 4.7.0\n' > 02-backend/tex2pdf-service/CHANGELOG.md && ls -la 02-backend/tex2pdf-service/CHANGELOG.md
cat > /workspace/.build-logs/bmds_fix.sh <<'FIXEOF'
#!/bin/bash
ROOT=/workspace
LOGS=$ROOT/.build-logs
STAGE=$LOGS/stage
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
export DUMMY_USER=x DUMMY_TOKEN=x
PYIMG=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm

for addon in api executors; do
  name="demospipes-bmds-$addon"
  d="$STAGE/$name"
  cd="${d/\/workspace/\/w}"
  rm -rf "$d" && mkdir -p "$d"
  # stage the bmds addons root (api/, executors/, data_structures/)
  rsync -a --exclude '.git' --exclude '.venv' --exclude '__pycache__' "$ROOT/02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/" "$d/"
  # external path dep: data-structures (../../../data-structures)
  rsync -a --exclude '.git' --exclude '.venv' --exclude '__pycache__' "$ROOT/02-backend/demospipes/data-structures/" "$d/data-structures/"
  docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w "$PYIMG" python3 /w/.build-logs/rewrite_paths.py "$cd" >> "$LOGS/bmds-relock.log" 2>&1 || true
  for pp in api executors data_structures data-structures; do
    [ -f "$d/$pp/pyproject.toml" ] && ( cd "$d/$pp" && timeout 300 uv lock >> "$LOGS/bmds-relock.log" 2>&1 )
  done
  docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w "$PYIMG" python3 /w/.build-logs/patch_dockerfile.py "$cd" >> "$LOGS/bmds-relock.log" 2>&1
  # base image local tags
  sed -i -E 's|^FROM <CONTAINER_REGISTRY>/demospipes-base-api:.*|FROM demospipes-base-api|; s|^FROM <CONTAINER_REGISTRY>/demospipes-base-executors:.*|FROM demospipes-base-executors|' "$d/$addon/Dockerfile"
  # local wheels for path deps
  mkdir -p "$d/local-wheels"
  ( cd "$d/data-structures" && uv build --wheel --out-dir "$d/local-wheels" >> "$LOGS/bmds-relock.log" 2>&1 ) || echo "WHEELFAIL data-structures" >> "$LOGS/bmds.log"
  ( cd "$d/data_structures" && uv build --wheel --out-dir "$d/local-wheels" >> "$LOGS/bmds-relock.log" 2>&1 ) || echo "WHEELFAIL data_structures" >> "$LOGS/bmds.log"
  docker run --rm -v /workspace:/w "$PYIMG" python3 /w/.build-logs/fix_pipwheel.py "$cd/$addon/Dockerfile" >> "$LOGS/bmds-relock.log" 2>&1
  DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build \
    --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=$DUMMY_USER \
    --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=$DUMMY_TOKEN \
    -f "$addon/Dockerfile" -t "$name" "$d" >> "$LOGS/bmds.log" 2>&1
  echo "$? $name" >> "$LOGS/bmds-results"
  echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] built $name rc=$?" >> "$LOGS/bmds.log"
done
FIXEOF
chmod +x /workspace/.build-logs/bmds_fix.sh && nohup /workspace/.build-logs/bmds_fix.sh > /workspace/.build-logs/bmds.out 2>&1 & echo "bmds PID $!"
